title: Jar

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Catching Fireflies, Holding Jam or Dye

body:
"Can be filled by clicking on fireflies around the map which can be found at night, if the jar is filled you can resell it to the Resource Hub for a profit! You can also use these for the Machine to create dyes and jams."

The Jar is a tool that is used to catch Fireflies, storing Jams and Dyes.

Details

By equipping the Jar, the player can interact with swarms of Fireflies that will eventually fill up the Jar. A Jar that is full of Fireflies can be taken back to the Resource Hub and sold for a profit.

Using Press Machine, Jars can be filled with Fruits and Flowers to corresponding Jams and Dyes. Both can be sold to gain profit, but Dyes are used as paint with Dye Machine.

As of 1.54.3, Empty Jars cannot be sold. This is to avoid confusion.

Outdated Tips

  • Selling Jars is an easy way to earn cash early in the game. Even the cheapest Firefly variants will always turn a profit, so it is impossible to lose more than what is gained.
  • There are two drawbacks to this method: Fireflies only spawn and persist at night, which means that they will disappear at sunrise, and this method also requires players to have enough money to purchase Jars.

Tips

  • Selling Jars is an easy way to earn cash early in the game. Jars now sell every firefly variant 2000$ cheaper than they were. The fireflies empty out of the jar and the jar does not sell itself with fireflies anymore.
  • There are two drawbacks to this method: Fireflies only spawn and persist at night, which means that they will disappear at sunrise, and this method also requires players to have enough money to purchase Jars.
